title.narrative: UN Women -The Chief Kachindamoto Fund- Ending Child Marriages and Promoting Girls’ Education in Malawi Programme

description.narrative:
The Ending Child Marriages and Promoting Girls Education Programme in Malawi, under the Chief Kachindamoto Fund (CKF) brings together bold cultural leadership, direct support for girls, and community-led transformation in a way that surpasses traditional, short-term project models. Its dual focus targets the most entrenched drivers of child marriage—limited opportunities for girls and harmful social norms—through a dedicated pooled fund rooted in cultural authority, girls’ empowerment, and community ownership.
Component 1: The Chief Kachindamoto Fund (CKF) is a grant-making mechanism to catalyze change and end child marriages in Malawi. The CKF supports initiatives that empower traditional leaders to champion gender equality by celebrating positive cultural practices and eliminating harmful ones.
Component 2: Gender mainstreaming across social sectors.
